blurb: Guests can take fishing charters targeting spotted seatrout, redfish, and flounder using light tackle. Trips also include a popular 20-mile riverfront tour on Bohicket Creek to see coastal birds such as eagles, ospreys, and pelicans. Captain Rob uses high quality Shakespeare tackle and has won awards for his inshore boat.
